Tags.rationale: ChompersNormal.cs:10 declares EncounterTag.Chomper (single element). `_hive_rooms()` pins the identical tag under "chompers". As with the other Hive units, tag-based no-repeat picking lives at the room/act picker (seam/rooms_and_map), not on the sim's `Encounter` object; this record only verifies the declared tag value is transcribed.

RoomType.rationale: ChompersNormal.cs:12 => RoomType.Monster. "chompers" is placed in `_hive_rooms().normal_keys` and nowhere else, matching the pool-classification convention used throughout this batch (RoomType lives at the pool-membership level in the sim, not as an `Encounter` field).

AllPossibleMonsters.maps_to: no per-encounter counterpart; full_env.py::_monster_classes() (global Monster-subclass walk)
AllPossibleMonsters.rationale: ChompersNormal.cs:14 declares a single-element list containing only `Chomper` -- and GenerateMonsters draws exclusively from that one class too, so C#'s declared superset already equals its actual roster space. Same consumer census as the rest of this batch: `ActModel.AllMonsters` -> `ModelDb.Monsters` reaches only `UnlockConsoleCmd.cs` (dev console) and `NGeneralStatsGrid.cs:164` (bestiary ratio), both UI/debug with no sim equivalent; the sim's real vocabulary need (`full_env.py::MONSTER_IDS`) is satisfied by the global `_monster_classes()` walk regardless. Cost: none observed.

GenerateMonsters.rationale: ChompersNormal.cs:16-26: two `Chomper` instances, zero RNG draws -- the first plain, the second with `ScreamFirst = true` set directly on the mutable clone before either is returned, both tuples carrying a `null` slot. `chomper.py`'s `ChompersEncounter.create_monsters` returns `[Chomper(hooks, rng), Chomper(hooks, rng, scream_first=True)]` -- same order (plain first, ScreamFirst second), same zero-draw count (no `selection_rng` branch exists in this override at all, matching the C# body having no `base.Rng` call), and no slot assignment (matching both C# tuples' `null`). Roster, order, flag and draw count all match exactly.

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.rationale: `EncounterModel.cs:39` default (`=> false`), not overridden by the sealed `ChompersNormal`. The sim's `Encounter` is never registered with `HookSystem` in `combat.py`, matching the C# guarantee that the encounter object itself is not a listener.

guards.what: Gold ladder (MinGoldReward/MaxGoldReward) and ShouldGiveRewards -- both inherited, not overridden by ChompersNormal
guards.rationale: RoomType.Monster => 10-20 gold (EncounterModel.cs:64-81), matched by `rewards.py:170-173`'s `GOLD_REWARD_RANGES[RoomType.MONSTER] = (10, 20)` (non-ascension baseline; Poverty scaling out of scope per rewards.py:32 and the audit prompt). `ShouldGiveRewards` default `true` (EncounterModel.cs:62) matched by `Encounter.should_give_rewards`'s dataclass default, unmodified by `CHOMPERS_NORMAL = ChompersEncounter(id="chompers_normal")`.
